description: List recent webhook deliveries (status, attempts, response status, last error) for debugging. Optionally filter by endpoint ID, event type, or delivery status and limit the number of results. Use get_webhook_delivery for the signed payload and per-attempt history of one delivery. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY to be set.

endpointId.description: Optional endpoint ID to filter deliveries (from list_webhook_endpoints).

eventType.description: Optional event type to filter deliveries.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of deliveries to return (1-200).

status.description: Optional delivery status to filter by.

name: get_webhook_deliveries
